xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3929: Skill text still names deleted status fields (readyForMerge, mergeStatus, reviewStatus) in pipeline-status, pipeline-list, pan-recap, pan-rollout, pan-tts

plan.title: Skill text still names deleted status fields (readyForMerge, mergeStatus, reviewStatus) in pipeline-status, pipeline-list, pan-recap, pan-rollout, pan-tts
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: The Cut (PAN-3917) deleted the stored status layer, but five agent-shipped skills still instruct agents to read the deleted fields: pipeline-status queries a review_status SQLite table that no longer exists (verified: the live panopticon.db has no such table, so the skill fails on its first query), pipeline-list branches on readyForMerge/mergeStatus, pan-recap annotates in-flight issues with readyForMerge, pan-rollout names releaseStatus, and pan-tts maps a voice to reviewStatus.passed. scripts/guard-no-state-layer.sh missed all of them because its Markdown pass deliberately omits the field names (header comment lines 22-29) while the code pass includes them. The issue body counts 33 hits; on this branch the full code-pass pattern set finds 17 camelCase occurrences plus snake_case review_status column references, all confined to these five files.
narratives.Proposal: Rewrite each of the five skills to the derived model (DerivedIssueState in packages/contracts/src/derived-issue-state.ts: state, attention, pr.reviewState, pr.checks, pr.mergeable), sourcing batch state from GET /api/issues/resource-allocated and per-issue attention/PR facts from `pan show <id> --json` only for in-review, changes-requested, and ready members. Widen the guard's Markdown pass to the code pass's full pattern set, rewrite the header paragraph that argued for the narrow set, add the first tests that exercise the Markdown pass (no scan-root argument), and document the widened scan in docs/SKILLS-CONVENTION.md. Six items: one per skill file (independent of each other) and one for the guard, which is blocked by the five because `npm run lint` is red until both halves land. Full detail, before/after snippets, and decisions D1-D9 are in .pan/drafts/pan-3929.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new REST endpoint for batch derived state; skills use /api/issues/resource-allocated plus `pan show --json` (D8).
- No edits to roles/*.md, docs/KANBAN-MODEL.md, docs/AGENT_TYPES_INDEX.md, or docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, which also name deleted fields but are outside the guard's Markdown roots and outside this issue; filed as follow-up PAN-3934 (D9).
- No change to the guard's code pass, its scan roots (src/, src/lib/cloister/prompts/, sync-sources/), or its two by-name exemptions.
- No change to pipeline-list's --all verifying bucket or its verifying_on_main check.
- No restyling of skill prose beyond the sentences that name deleted fields or carry the replacement data flow.
- No changes to pan show, pan rollout, pan tts, or any dashboard route or contract type.

autoDecisions.summary: pipeline-status reads batch `state` from /api/issues/resource-allocated and calls `pan show <id> --json` only for in-review / changes-requested / ready members.
autoDecisions.rationale: No REST route returns the full DerivedIssueState in batch; `pan show` spawns a process and does forge reads per issue, so calling it for all ~40 members would take over a minute. PR columns only carry information for those three states.

autoDecisions.summary: pipeline-status columns become STATE, NEEDS, PR-REVIEW, CHECKS, MERGEABLE; the TEST/VERIFY columns and the `*` drift glyph are dropped.
autoDecisions.rationale: The derived model has no test verdict; pr.checks is the nearest observable. Nothing stored can drift any more, so the PAN-1027 drift flag has no referent.

autoDecisions.summary: pipeline-list lifecycle view puts post_merge_limbo membership in Ship and deletes the mergeStatus clause.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors getPipelineIssuePhase line 96, the frontend's own rule; /api/issues carries no derived state.
One of the four LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES in tts-playback.ts and the natural 'work is done' announcement.

autoDecisions.summary: The guard's Markdown pass adopts the code pass's full set including auto-commit and recoveryTrips.
autoDecisions.rationale: Running the full set over sync-sources/ and src/lib/cloister/prompts/ on 2026-09-19 hit only the five files in scope, so there are no false positives to trade off against.

autoDecisions.summary: roles/*.md and docs/*.md hits are deferred to follow-up issue PAN-3934.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names five skills and the guard's Markdown roots; roles/ is not scanned by the guard. Filing rather than silently widening scope.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W1 exactly (.pan/drafts/pan-3929.md). Update the frontmatter phase list, the output-format example, the cell-semantics table (remove the `*` row), and the Columns table so the five status columns become STATE / NEEDS / PR-REVIEW / CHECKS / MERGEABLE sourced from /api/issues/resource-allocated `.state` and `pan show <id> --json` `.attention` / `.pr.*`. Rewrite step 2 (Awaiting Merge) to filter resource-allocated rows with state == 'ready' that are pipeline members. Update the Notes section (derived state instead of review status; delete the drift bullet). Do not change the membership fetch, the planning-sessions section, or the sort order.
